pretreatment: degreased in acetone, electropolished in a solution of HClO4 and ethanol (1:4, v/v) at 20 V for 5–10 min or until a mirrorlike surface was achieved
evidence: Aluminum sheets (Alfa Aesar, 99.998% pure, 0.5 mm thick) were degreased in acetone. The Al sheets were then electropolished in a solution of HClO4 and ethanol (1:4, v/v) at 20 V for 5–10 min or until a mirrorlike surface was achieved.
